fotballkamp.title: Tonight's rules
items: Goal: fans of the team that conceded drink three.
Own goal: everyone drinks – and fans of the team that scored it drink two extra.
Yellow card: fans of the team that got it drink one.
Red card: five sips for the fans.
Penalty given: everyone drinks one. Miss: the shooter's fans drink three.
VAR check: everyone drinks one while waiting.
Offside: fans of the offside team drink one.
Post or crossbar: everyone drinks one.
Keeper saves a penalty: the keeper's fans hand out three.
A player rolls around on the ground for more than ten seconds: everyone drinks.
The commentator says “of all time”: everyone drinks.
The commentator mispronounces a name: whoever spots it hands out two.
Substitution: fans of the team making the sub drink one.
Close-up of the manager chewing gum: drink one.
A player kisses the badge on their shirt: their fans drink two.
Corner: fans of the team that gets it hand out one.
Free kick in shooting range: everyone drinks one.
Goal from a free kick: everyone finishes their drink.
Hat-trick: everyone finishes their drink and toasts the scorer.
The captain argues with the ref: their fans drink one.
The crowd sings loud enough to hear on TV: everyone drinks one.
The ball goes into the crowd: whoever's sitting closest to the TV drinks.
A goal is disallowed: the fans who celebrated drink two.
More than five minutes of stoppage time: everyone drinks one.
Half-time: whoever supports the team that's losing fetches drinks for everyone.
Someone in the room celebrates before the ball goes in: they drink two.
Someone in the room says “I'd have scored that”: drink one.
Someone in the room yells at the ref: drink one.
The keeper goes up for a corner: everyone drinks.
A shot goes way over the bar: the shooter's fans drink one.
Close-up of a celebrity in the stands: everyone drinks.
The commentator mentions Haaland: everyone drinks.
Level at half-time: everyone toasts.
The match ends 0–0: everyone finishes their drink.
Your team wins: hand out five sips.

eurovision.title: Tonight's rules
items: Key change: everyone drinks.
Wind machine: everyone drinks.
Pyrotechnics: everyone drinks one.
A song in a language nobody understands: everyone drinks.
A country sings in English even though they have their own language: drink one.
The host makes a joke that falls flat: everyone drinks.
Someone dances in folk costume: everyone drinks one.
A performer is wearing more glitter than fabric: drink one.
The song is about love: whoever picked that country drinks one.
“Europe, start voting now!”: everyone toasts.
A performer has been in the contest before: drink one.
Last year's winner shows up: drink one.
The camera shows someone in the audience crying: drink one.
Animal or mascot on stage: everyone drinks.
Someone plays an instrument you clearly can't hear: drink one.
The performer lifts the mic stand: drink one.
The performer goes down into the audience: everyone drinks.
“Douze points” to your country: hand out two.
“Nul points” to your country: finish your drink.
Norway gets points: everyone toasts.
Norway gets zero points: everyone drinks – and remembers Jahn Teigen (Norway's legendary nul points).
Sweden gives Norway points: everyone toasts.
Norway gives Sweden twelve points: everyone drinks, bitterly.
A country gives twelve points to its neighbour: drink one.
The points reading drags on: everyone drinks.
Someone says “Good evening Europe!” in a thick accent: drink one.
Falsetto: drink one.
Someone in the room sings along to a song they claim not to know: that person drinks.
Someone in the room says “this is just politics”: drink one.
Costume change mid-song: everyone drinks.
The performer lies down on stage: everyone drinks.
Wind machine and key change in the same song: everyone finishes their drink.
The hosts change outfits: drink one.
The song is in more than one language: drink one.
Your song wins: hand out five sips.
